scope: Checkpoint selection, sealed-challenge unlock, and final ONNX-readiness gates for the controlled ML-v1 versus ML-v1.1 data experiment

metric_definitions.entity_matching: exact character span and entity class
metric_definitions.macro: unweighted mean across entity labels with positive gold support in that evaluation view
metric_definitions.micro: aggregate exact-span true positives, false positives, and false negatives
metric_definitions.record_error_rate: records with any exact-span false positive, false negative, boundary error, or wrong-class error divided by all records
metric_definitions.context_target_error_rate: records where the annotated contrast target is not decoded with its expected entity label, or an O contrast target overlaps any predicted entity, divided by all records
metric_definitions.morphology_over_context_error_rate: BUSINESS_ID contrast records decoded as SSN, CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER, or BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, plus O technical-reference records decoded as IP_ADDRESS, divided by applicable records
metric_definitions.category_error_rate: record_error_rate calculated independently for one meta.contrast_category
metric_definitions.unexplained_alignment_failure: a failed alignment other than tokenizer_emitted_no_token_for_span or token_boundary_adjustment_exceeds_three_characters

sealed_challenge_unlock.decision_on_failure: NOT READY FOR SEALED CHALLENGE EVALUATION
sealed_challenge_unlock.rationale: The standard-dev floors allow at most one absolute percentage point below the frozen ML-v1 best-dev values. The challenge thresholds require a material BUSINESS_ID recall gain, retained SSN recall, broad supported-label accuracy, and low record/context-conflict error before the sealed set can be opened.
